name: Habitat
description: Habitat scientific workshop: sandboxed NumPy, SciPy, SymPy, pandas, Matplotlib and Pillow with persistent software projects, memory, skills and optional phenomena.
notes: S020a workshop image is selected by immutable local OCI configuration ID. Operator provisioning only; no pulls or pip at runtime. Network-free rootless containers retain workspace-only writes. All earlier Habitat tools remain, plus python.packages. No models.ask, inference or full inhabitant demonstration. Existing world versions retain their original image and limits.
